quotes.quote: Adds BFLOAT16 support to kornia.constants.DType, fixing KeyError: 'BFLOAT16' for mix augmentations when the input tensor uses torch.bfloat16.

This enables `RandomMosaic`, `RandomMixUpV2`, `RandomCutMixV2`, and `RandomJigsaw `to run with `bfloat16 `inputs instead of failing during dtype resolution. The affected CPU bfloat16 strict-xfail entries are also updated now that these tests can execute.
